basics.name: Rohan Mehrotra
basics.title: Senior Full-stack Engineer
basics.summary: Eight years building data-heavy web products for logistics and fintech teams. I lead small teams, own systems end to end, and prefer fewer moving parts.

experience.title: Lead Engineer
experience.summary: Lead a team of four building Dispatch, the carrier's route planning and driver app.
bullets: Designed the PostGIS routing pipeline; planning time per route fell from 40 minutes to under 5
Replaced a Kubernetes deployment with two instances and a single CI job, cutting infrastructure cost by roughly half
Set up on-call rotation and runbooks; no unplanned downtime in the last twelve months

experience.title: Backend Engineer
experience.summary: Owned the ledger and reconciliation services for a payments platform processing a few hundred thousand transactions a day.
bullets: Rebuilt nightly reconciliation as a staged SQL pipeline; runtime dropped from 6 hours to 35 minutes
Introduced an audit table that made every unmatched transaction explainable to finance without engineering help
Led two Postgres major-version upgrades with zero data loss

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.summary: Built internal tools for a geological survey firm, including the first version of Fieldnotes.
bullets: Shipped an offline-first React Native app used daily by a team of twelve surveyors
Wrote the data import pipeline that replaced manual transcription of field notes
Mentored two interns who both joined full time

education.note: Final-year project on spatial indexing for mobile databases
